Name: Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form
Description: This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

schema.name: MetaKey
schema.Description: The metadata key. Unique within the table.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Order 1. Mirrors MetaKey so the row is addressable by Name.

schema.name: ValueType
schema.Description: How to read the value: 'string' uses StringValue, 'object' or 'array' parse JsonValue.

schema.name: StringValue
schema.Description: The value when ValueType is 'string'.

schema.name: JsonValue
schema.Description: The value as JSON when ValueType is 'object' or 'array'.

data.StringValue: Talisman's South Park ontology explainer, with a rulebook underneath
data.Name: title

data.StringValue: The model follows the explainer page's own script as read on 2026-11-26: its ten facts, five rules, property wiring, provenance wording and the one-current-grade-and-role policy. Her starting state is the seed: facts on, rules off.
data.Name: reference_note

data.StringValue: Character and location portraits are Fandom images, linked from each Things row; South Park is the work of Trey Parker and Matt Stone.
data.Name: image_credit

ERBTables.Description: One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

schema.name: ERBTableId
schema.Description: The concept table's name: this row's key.

schema.name: TableName
schema.Description: The table's name again, as a plain column.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: What the table holds. Follows the table.

schema.name: IsMetaTable
schema.Description: True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

schema.name: IsTenantScoped
schema.Description: The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

schema.name: TenantParentTable
schema.Description: The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

schema.name: TenantParentField
schema.Description: The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

schema.name: SortOrder
schema.Description: Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

schema.name: Label
schema.Description: For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

schema.name: Portrait
schema.Description: For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

schema.name: IsUserAddable
schema.Description: For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

schema.name: IsSymmetric
schema.Description: For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

schema.name: ValueNodeLabel
schema.Description: For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

schema.name: CurrentValueWording
schema.Description: For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

schema.name: InputName
schema.Description: For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

schema.name: RecordKind
schema.Description: For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

schema.name: RecordOrder
schema.Description: For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

schema.name: InverseOf
schema.Description: The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

schema.name: ChainFirst
schema.Description: With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

schema.name: ChainSecond
schema.Description: The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

schema.name: DisjointWith
schema.Description: Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.
